name: Methyl dihydroxybenzoate
description: Methyl dihydroxybenzoate ( CAS 2150-46-1 ), also known as methyl gentisate, is an ester derivative of gentisic acid used across pharmaceutical, cosmetic, and food-related applications as an antioxidant and stabilizing agent. Its dual hydroxyl functionality makes it effective at scavenging free radicals in formulations where oxidative degradation is a primary concern. In pharmaceutical manufacturing, methyl gentisate serves as a key intermediate in the synthesis of active compounds. It is frequently incorporated into topical formulations requiring antioxidant protection. Cosmetic formulators use it in skin care products, particularly creams and serums, where it helps protect sensitive ingredients from oxidative breakdown. This compound supports product shelf life and maintains the integrity of complex formulations. In food-adjacent applications, it functions as a stabilizer in packaging or ingredient systems where oxidative stability is required. Its role as a pharmaceutical intermediate also positions it in research and development pipelines targeting anti-inflammatory and antioxidant drug candidates. Methyl dihydroxybenzoate is typically supplied as a white to off-white crystalline powder. It is available in technical and pharmaceutical-grade specifications to meet the purity requirements of different manufacturing environments. Our material is produced to meet rigorous quality standards including USP and BP requirements. Packaging ranges from small research quantities to bulk industrial volumes, with documentation support available for regulated industries.
